decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a mini cab control centre shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 4 - Planning permission is hereby granted for the use of the site for the purposes of a mini cab control and booking centre/Courier service only,  and which shall not be used as a centre for drivers or customers.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that this application for the change of use from a Courier service to mini cab control centre/courier service is acceptable and would maintain and preserve the character of the streetscene and would enhance the vitality of the parade and Brentford Town Centre. It would not have an unacceptable impact upon the surrounding environment or upon neighbours' living conditions. It complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and S.1.3 (Non-retail uses in secondary frontages).
description: Change of use from courier service to mini cab use/courier service.
